page.overview:
Who is Bedoli?

Bedoli is a citizen of , located on the . She and live together in a home near . During the day, she can be found walking around .

When spoken to initially, Bedoli asks if has seen Divine Beast Vah Medoh, admitting everyone in the village is unsure what to do. Every time she looks up, she can't help but sigh, and she wonders when the village will be able to relax again.

After Vah Medoh has been appeased, Bedoli becomes so excited she doesn't realize that she's started singing an old song. She asks Link if he heard her sing. If Link asks Bedoli to teach him, she claims that's embarrassing. However, while Bedoli sings the song for Link, she doesn't remember all of it. She directs Link to find Laissa, which initiates the "The Ancient Rito Song".

Speaking to Laissa, she comments that Bedoli's memory is terrible. She's able to recite the whole song, and she's not sure what it means. At any time afterwards, Link can approach Bedoli to have her recite the song again.
